name: endnote-mcp
description: Search, cite, and read PDFs from your EndNote library in Claude.
long_description: Connect your EndNote reference library to Claude Desktop. Provides 12 tools for searching references by metadata, full-text search inside PDFs, semantic similarity search, generating citations in multiple styles (APA, Harvard, Vancouver, Chicago, IEEE), exporting BibTeX, and reading PDF pages directly. On first launch, indexes your library automatically — metadata is searchable in seconds; PDF text extraction and semantic embeddings continue in the background.

endnote_xml.title: EndNote XML Export
endnote_xml.description: Your EndNote XML file. Export from EndNote: File → Export → choose XML format.

pdf_dir.title: PDF Attachments Folder
pdf_dir.description: The folder containing your PDF attachments — usually inside your library's .Data/PDF directory (or PDF/ inside an .enlp package).

extract_pdf_text.title: Enable full-text PDF search
extract_pdf_text.description: Extracts text from your PDFs so Claude can find quotes and passages inside papers. Adds about 1 minute per 100 PDFs on first launch (runs in the background — the server is usable immediately).

semantic_search.title: Enable semantic search
semantic_search.description: Uses AI embeddings so Claude can find papers by meaning, not just keywords. Downloads a ~100 MB model on first use.

max_pdf_pages.title: Maximum pages per PDF read
max_pdf_pages.description: How many pages Claude can read from a single PDF in one tool call.

tools.name: search_references
tools.description: Search by title, author, keywords, or abstract.

tools.name: search_fulltext
tools.description: Search inside the PDF content of your references.

tools.name: search_semantic
tools.description: Find papers by meaning using AI embeddings.

tools.name: get_reference_details
tools.description: Get full metadata for a reference.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: Format a single reference as a citation.

tools.name: get_bibliography
tools.description: Format multiple references as a bibliography.

tools.name: read_pdf_section
tools.description: Read pages from a reference's PDF.

tools.name: list_references_by_topic
tools.description: List references on a broad topic.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Find references related to a given reference.

tools.name: rebuild_index
tools.description: Re-index after adding new EndNote references.
